meta.title: feat: Add includeStackTrace option to reduce LLM token usage by 80-90%
meta.body_summary: Add an optional includeStackTrace boolean parameter to get_console_logs tool/resource to exclude stack traces and reduce LLM token consumption by up to 80-90%, with backward-compatible default true.

perf_labels.notes: Claude Code added includeStackTrace flag to skip stack traces, dramatically reducing token usage; approved with a nitpick and merged quickly.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 134 changed lines across 7 files, this is a small edit by absolute volume. It fits a small-step, targeted optimization PR and is consistent with the successful merge.

review_details.concern_detail: CodeRabbit suggested adding validation for includeStackTrace parameter to provide better error messages for invalid inputs.
review_details.performance_claim: Excluding stack traces reduces token usage by 80-90% for console logs.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Adding an optional filter parameter to an existing tool is a well-scoped feature within agent capability; no low-level optimization or complex algorithm required.

detection_detail.code_reading: Maintainer CoderGamester approved after reviewing the changes and the PR's performance claims.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: PR body provides example before/after token counts and testing notes, but no automated benchmark or profiler output.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regression introduced; merge was smooth.

core_change_summary.description: Added an optional includeStackTrace boolean parameter to the get_console_logs tool and resource across Unity (C#) and Node.js (TypeScript/JavaScript) layers, defaulting to true for backward compatibility; when false, stack traces are omitted from log JSON output to reduce LLM token usage.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Build JavaScript files reflect the same changes as the TypeScript sources.
change_trajectory: Single commit added includeStackTrace parameter across C# services, TypeScript tool and resource handlers, and updated the build outputs accordingly.

CodeRabbit suggested validating includeStackTrace parameter values for better error messages.
Maintainer approved with positive feedback: 'Very good PR to help reduce token consumption LGTM.'
